question: What happens when one established in the nonconceptual path enters through any level of reality?
premises: One may be established in the nonconceptual path.
Entry may occur through any path from earth up to Sadashiva.
The result is determined by that nonconceptual establishment.
inference: Therefore, for one established in the nonconceptual path, entry through any level from earth to Sadashiva results in becoming Shiva.
plain_english: One who is established in the nonconceptual path, by whatever route they enter—from the earth principle up to Sadashiva—through that very route becomes Shiva.
